visualCharacteristics.purpose: expandable question-and-answer list with plus/minus toggles
visualCharacteristics.description: Stack of items separated by 1px light-grey dividers; bold question with a green plus icon that becomes a minus when open; rich answer text below. Fills the width of its column, so it works in a full-width section or a 3/4 column.

contentPattern.structure: One row per item. Cell 1: question (plain text). Cell 2: answer (paragraphs, lists, links). Rows with both cells empty are ignored; a missing answer cell gives an item with an empty panel
contentPattern.description: Question "What are the benefits of fiber cement siding?" | Answer paragraphs with optional lists and links

usage: Use for FAQ lists and installation Q&A sections.
reuseGuidance: Use open-first to show the first answer on load; use exclusive when only one answer should stay open.
